summary: Paint the Fractal workspace shell in the saved dark or light scheme before hydration, with a navigation skeleton and explicit application readiness milestones.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Web shell presentation and readiness measurements only. No client protocol or persisted-state migration. Cold-open story plays cover both schemes and reject injected white-page and missing-skeleton regressions.
